Quantum 1.34.0 was certified on 2026-09-19. It pins **nucleus v1.30.0**, **quark v1.14.0** and **orbit v1.10.2**, with 23 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.33.0: nucleus goes from v1.29.0 to v1.30.0 (minor), orbit goes from v1.10.1 to v1.10.2 (patch) and quark stays at v1.14.0. 16 sibling modules change version.
